g.text: BankDash Services Catalog Interaction & Animation Locators
Visual mapping of 3 key interactive zones: highlight cards, service items & modal drawers
Highlight Cards Soft Elevation & Squircle Zoom
Life Insurance, Shopping & Safety cards with squircle icon scale & subtle shadow lift
TRIGGER: Mouse hover over highlight cards
Horizontal Service Card Elevation & Metadata Glow
6 bespoke banking service cards with multi-column metadata, category icons & smooth hover glow
TRIGGER: Cursor hover over service rows
View Details Action & Interactive Modal Dialog
Prominent action buttons trigger full modal dialog with service specs, tier benefits,
and instant automated banking representative callback request
TRIGGER: Clicking View Details on any service card
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
